this project fully tunes only the image encoder for supervised multiclass classification.", "The publication learns contrastive temperature and evaluates initial values 0.07, 0.5, 1.0, and 10.0; this classifier has no temperature parameter.", "The official code uses layer-wise learning-rate decay of 0.7 and steps its scheduler per minibatch;
